_: The film language of “The Crime of the Fallen Leaf” (docs/stories/leaf-story.md): tripod; the square — frontal, like a canvas; the inner world — a white field and suprematist geometry drawn by the engine (shape, trace, spin, fall — stage/js/geometry.js).

language.editing: The city — short shots (3–6 s), a motley rhythm; the inner world — long shots (15–30 s), no cuts inside a thought. The transition “inwards” — the square loses its colour and goes to white (light white).
language.camera: Tripod (hand 0). The square — frontal, like a painted canvas; the inner world — slow axial push-ins through layers of geometry; Ranum's turning into the pilot — one long camera flight.
language.people: Ranum is still: the decision, the judgement and the forgiveness are in a motionless figure; what moves is the world, the lines, the aeroplane, the leaf.
language.light_color: The outer world — motley bright painting; the inner one — a white field, black and red; the finale — the painting muted, the leaf the only living green (glow).
language.elements: Lines that draw themselves (trace + grow): arabesques in the sand, a fiery circle, a passer-by's path, the dashed curve of a bomb; shapes (shape): a point, coal, a ring, street stripes; rotation with a trail (spin, trail) — a sphere; the leaf's fall (fall).
language.time: Pauses after the answers of the Initiation and after “I will not let it come to pass”.
language.sound: The city — noise, tram bells; the inner world — a drone; the aeroplane — a drilling roar; the finale — the rustle of a maple.
